decision_conditions: The proposed vehicular crossover, by reason of its design would need to cross the pavement along Blewitts Cottages via the grassed verge, increasing the potential for conflict between vehicles and pedestrians, which would be detrimental to the safety of pedestrians, contrary to Local Plan Policy 24, Policy T6.1 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy TR6 (4) of the NPPF.

The proposed vehicular crossover would result in vehicles driving over the grass verge in front of the site to access the driveway of the subject property, something which would result in its degradation thereby diminishing its contribution to the visual amenity of the locality, contrary to Policy DP3 2(g) of the NPPF, Local Plan Policy 27 and Policy D4 of the London Plan.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reasons for it was given to the applicant via email on 29/09/2026.
